meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以查看、添加或删除允许代理容器访问的主机目录列表。它会读取配置文件，显示当前允许的目录及其读写权限，并帮你修改。
howto.when: 当你提到“mounts”、“mount allowlist”、“agent access to directories”或“container mounts”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 显示当前允许代理访问的目录列表。
say.note: Claude 会读取配置文件并展示。

say.text: 添加 /data/projects 目录，允许读写。
say.note: Claude 会验证路径并更新配置。

say.text: 移除 /tmp 目录的访问权限。
say.note: Claude 会从列表中删除该条目。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can view, add, or remove the list of host directories that agent containers are allowed to access. It reads the config file, shows current allowed directories and their read/write permissions, and helps you modify them.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", or "container mounts".

say_en.text: Show the current list of directories agents can access.
say_en.note: Claude will read the config file and display it.
Claude will validate the path and update the config.
Claude will delete that entry from the list.
